headline: Site Foreman
summary: Site foreman with fourteen years on houses, schools, warehouses and bridges in Isabela and the Cagayan Valley. I prepare sites, set up temporary facilities, lead carpentry, masonry and electrical crews of up to 40 workers, and inspect work and safety every day. I read plans and take-offs as well as any engineer and report progress and risks clearly.
highlights: Led construction of a 20-classroom school building, finished two weeks early with no lost-time accidents.
Trained more than 30 helpers who became carpenters and masons.
Recovered a delayed warehouse project by resequencing crews, meeting the owner's deadline.
skills: Construction safety and daily site inspection

experience.title: Site Foreman
bullets: Lead crews of up to 40 carpenters, masons, steelmen and electricians on public and private projects.
Set up site offices, bunkhouses, fencing and temporary power before each project.
Inspect work quality and safety daily and report progress and risks to the project engineer.

experience.title: Leadman (Carpentry and Masonry)
bullets: Led carpentry and masonry teams on houses, warehouses and a river bridge.
Checked levels and dimensions and computed material needs from the plans.
